issue.title: Residual just test-visual golden drift: 29 PNG snapshots fail on clean master after sase-up's chrome-shift fix
issue.description:
`just test-visual` fails 29 of ~855 PNG goldens on a clean master tree (HEAD 457041681,
2026-09-05), unrelated to any pending change. Confirmed by stashing all local diffs
(the plans/202609/starting_agents_count_only.md fix) and re-running the identical
failing subset against clean master: the same 27 of the sampled 29 tests fail
byte-for-byte with no diff applied, with tiny changed-pixel ratios (roughly 0.06%-1.8%
changed pixels per golden), unlike the uniform 5181-pixel one-row chrome shift that
sase-up documented on 2026-08-27 (360/840 failing then). The failure count has since
dropped from 360 to 29, so sase-up's chrome-shift cause looks at least partly fixed,
but a smaller residual corpus of per-golden pixel drift remains and needs its own
investigation (font/renderer version drift is the leading suspect, since diffs are
small and vary per golden rather than sharing one fixed pixel count).

Representative failing nodes observed on 2026-09-05:

- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_agents.py::test_artifacts_agents_filter_parse_error_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clan_panel.py::test_epic_clan_panel_png_snapshots
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clan_panel.py::test_swarm_clan_panel_png_snapshots
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_preview_panel.py::test_preview_panel_active_search_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe.py::test_axe_lumberjack_tree_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_update_panel.py::test_update_panel_pending_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_link_reveal_chip.py::test_beads_link_reveal_chip_png_snapshots

Full 29-test list is in the `just test-visual` run captured in monitor npeatr4x3gms
(family 0gf) on this host, dated 2026-09-05.

Two of the originally-reported 29 (`config_center_plugins_not_uv_tool` and
`agents_external_repo_diff_file_panel`) passed on rerun, consistent with additional
flakiness layered on top of the deterministic subset -- worth separating flaky vs.
deterministic failures during triage.

Reproduce:

    just test-visual
    # inspect .pytest_cache/sase-visual/<node>/<golden>/{summary.txt,diff.png}

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduced deterministically by stashing all local changes and re-running the identical failing subset against clean master HEAD 457041681: the same 27 of 29 sampled tests fail again with matching diff artifacts, and the pending local diff (plans/202609/starting_agents_count_only.md) does not touch any of the failing goldens' subsystems.

payload.description: same broad category (test-visual red on master) but smaller/different signature (29 vs 360, variable pixel counts not one uniform shift) -- likely residual after sase-up's fix
